title: Ephemeral API key rebind during edge cutover causes transient tenant privilege drop
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: During an edge cutover for a Dedicated customer we observed a spike of 403s for a subset of API keys. Root cause analysis shows a narrow timing window where ephemeral API key regeneration + edge proxy sticky session handoff caused the tenant-to-apikey binding to flip. The platform briefly routed requests for CustomerX to the wrong tenant mapping (resulting in privilege drop/403) until the reconciliation completed.

Technical details: Dedicated control-plane issues a short-lived alias when a customer requests API key rotation. The edge cutover path runs an orchestration that: 1) pushes new alias, 2) triggers proxy hot-reload of tenant mapping, 3) invalidates in-memory apikey-authority cache. A race between hot-reload and in-flight token verification caused some requests to validate against the new alias but resolve the org mapping from the old cache shard. This produced transient misassignment for ~7s on affected nodes. The failing path is in auth/alias_rebind.go and the proxy header rewrite logic (edge/proxy/ingress_rewrite.go).

Impact: Started 2026-03-01T08:42 UTC, affected one Dedicated customer in us-east-1 during traffic cutover. Observed ~1.8k 403s, user-facing errors for non-idempotent API calls. PagerDuty: PD#8791. Incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2043.

Repro steps: 1) Configure Dedicated customer with short apikey alias TTL, 2) trigger apikey regenerate API, 3) simulate edge cutover with sticky-session reassignment across two proxy nodes and concurrent in-flight requests. Repro script in infra/playbooks/repro_ephemeral_rebind.sh.

Mitigation applied: Emergency gateway patch to accept previous alias for 60s while completing hot-reload; disabled immediate cache invalidation on control-plane during apikey swap. These mitigations were deployed as hotfixes 2026-03-01T09:10 UTC and rolled back to a more robust fix after testing.

Permanent fix plan: Implement atomic dual-binding window for apikey swaps (server-side atomic commit), add a short-lived fallback resolver in proxy that prefers explicit control-plane truth over in-memory cache during rebinding, and add end-to-end integration tests that simulate cutovers. Also add a reconciliation backoff and per-node drain to ensure no in-flight requests see partial state.

QA and rollout: Feature branch merged to infra with regression tests. Staged rollout to dedicated-us-east followed by global Dedicated fleet. Target release runtime-1.20 with feature flag "atomic_apikey_swap" behind enterprise toggles.

Monitoring and alerts: New Grafana panels for apikey-alias-change-rate and per-node alias-resolution-errors, and a P0 alert if >100 alias-resolution errors in 1m.

Postmortem action items (high level):
- Implement atomic swap (ENG-99641-ACTION-1)
- Add integration tests for edge cutovers (ENG-99641-ACTION-2)
- Harden proxy header rewrite logic and add canary rollout (ENG-99641-ACTION-3)
- Customer communication and credit applied to CustomerX (Support ticket #SUP-4421).
